question: Which source and assay-definition holds can the owner-supplied Tables S1-S6 resolve or narrow, while preserving exact author cells, namespace distinctions and unresolved spatial identities?
decision: Qualify source participation, clinical fields, aggregate TMA nesting and published gene/assay definitions; identify precise remaining inputs for stages 3-6 without fitting expression or spatial models.
strongest_rival: Merged-cell or checkmark parsing could invent sample independence, block/core identifiers or wrong clinical joins; MP/species/panel conflation could falsely imply endpoint availability or independent state definitions.
discriminator: Cell-linked extraction with bounded merged-range expansion, explicit two-block footnote, separate cohort/program/species/add-on namespaces, aggregate comparison with frozen GEO metadata and a separate openpyxl verifier. Unknown individual core/section/ROI mapping remains unknown.
exposure_record: Owner and parent chat supplied and inspected Tables S1-S6 before this freeze. Table schemas, counts, WES 79=Normal24+AAH11+AIS14+MIA4+LUAD26, Xenium participation, TMA totals, list namespaces, two custom add-ons and assay roles were exposed. This execution inspected workbook cells/layouts and prior v3 outcomes; no later freeze erases exposure.
biological_unit: Patients are biological units; immediate audited units are workbook cells, reported patient/histology groups, aggregate TMA groups and published gene-list entries.
nesting_and_overlap: Discovery tables and prior GEO outputs reuse the Peng cohort. Asterisks indicate two samples/tissue blocks, never two independent patients. TMA uses separately reported TMA P# labels; individual core/barcode identity and independence beyond reported cohort provenance are not verified.
population_and_selection: Exactly six user-supplied NIHMS2118436 supplementary workbooks S1-S6, hash-matched local ignored copies, prior verified metadata_v3 outputs and frozen A12 feature/response definitions. No new raw assay/library search.
contrast: Published platform participation and clinical metadata versus existing GEO record counts/fields; published gene lists and custom add-ons versus fixed A12 component and response membership; source requirements before versus after supplied tables.
endpoint: Auditable source-cell ledger, clinical comparisons, participation/count reconciliation, unresolved Xenium block candidates, merge-qualified TMA groups, namespaced gene inventories, published DEG and seqIF metadata, exact A12 list overlap and hold reassessment.
methods: Read OOXML cells, strings, merges and saved formula caches with Python standard library; execute no formulas or author code. Derive checkmark counts using A31 footnote and compare reported totals and prior GEO groups. Expand actual merges only. Preserve leading-zero slide IDs and raw lesion text without parsing parentheses. Exact symbol membership after trimming whitespace only; no ortholog/synonym mapping. Independent bundled openpyxl read checks source cells, merges, joins and arithmetic; no production parser import.
missingness_and_exclusions: Blank cells retain blank provenance; a blank participation cell is not marked, not proof of absent tissue. Original/reviewed P7 mapping and P6 VCF identity remain assessed separately. Unknown block/section/core IDs stay empty. Absent from custom add-on is distinct from unmeasured in full assay. Human and mouse lists are separate; DEG summaries are not raw outcomes.
multiplicity: Metadata enumeration and exact list membership only; no hypothesis tests, differential-expression reanalysis or favorable endpoint selection.
precision_basis: Finite source audit; no effect size, power, biological precision or cell-based patient inference.
interpretation_limit: New source access qualifies published definitions and aggregate provenance, not barcode pathology/ROI geometry, full measured panels, causal mechanism, clone/fate, independent validation or scientific acceptance. Existing A11/A12/A13 unfavorable findings remain.
stop_rule: Refuse checksum/schema/duplicate-key ambiguity, unsupported participation marks, overlapping merges or verifier disagreement. Record source conflicts rather than harmonize them. Preserve failed run bytes and use a new contract/version if code or design needs correction. No expression-derived labels, imputed panel genes or fabricated core/library IDs.
amendment_reason: Prospective source-addition stage after owner supplied Tables S1-S6. Extends source availability and reassesses holds; previous metadata_v3 code, outputs, contract and receipt remain immutable and are not rerun or replaced.
